metadata.title: Ehrhart theorem for integral-integral affine manifolds with corners
metadata.abstract: We study lattice-counting functions on compact integral-integral affine manifolds with corners, which generalize integral unimodular polytopes. We prove analogues of Ehrhart's theorem and Ehrhart-Macdonald reciprocity in this setting.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 带角仿射流形的 Ehrhart 理论
analysis.workSummary: 对紧 integral-integral 仿射带角流形证明格点计数的 Ehrhart 型定理与互反律。
analysis.breakthrough: 将整幺模多胞体的计数结构推广到流形。
analysis.limitations: 需要指定的双整仿射结构和紧致性，不是任意仿射流形计数。
